decisions.reason: As a large German door-system producer, the firm has already invested in and publicly presented this industrial sectional door, and with no clear sign of failure it is likely to continue backing a product that fits its core range.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door matches the firm's stated focus on compliant, thermal-performance solutions, so prior investment and strategic fit make withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door received its own webpage, the firm's public commitment to it appears especially visible, which under escalation of commitment supports keeping it unless results clearly deteriorate.
